note: All four screenshots were taken by the app's maker in this build session. The three covers are PNGs the app itself rendered through its own export path, scaled down to fit the size limits; the editor shot is the app running in desktop Chrome.

shots.caption: SUNSET HEIST
shots.shows: The cover: a full-bleed poster of the Sunset Heist sample photo, two characters against a Vice City sunset, bold pink caption at the bottom.
The app in desktop Chrome with the Sunset Heist photo loaded: layout toolbar, live preview canvas, and the control panel (photo, caption, grade, zoom, export).

shots.caption: NEON NIGHTS
shots.shows: A 2x2 grid cover: four different crops of the same photo (characters, ferris wheel and skyline, palms, close-up) under a cool neon grade.

shots.caption: BOULEVARD QUEEN
shots.shows: A hero cover: one large panel with the two characters and two small panels (skyline with ferris wheel, palms) under a warm golden grade.
